= BITwiki Query Patterns: SMW Query Syntax and Examples =

== Etymology: The Art of Asking ==

''Query'' — from Latin ''quaerere'', to ask, to seek, to inquire. A query is not a demand but a question—an opening toward discovery. The Latin root carries the sense of seeking with effort, of pursuing what is not yet known.

''Pattern'' — from Latin ''patronus'', protector, defender, from ''pater'', father. A pattern is that which protects the shape, that which preserves the form. In query patterns, we preserve the shapes of effective asking.

== Purpose: Queries as Discovery Tools ==

This document provides query patterns for Semantic MediaWiki (SMW) in BITwiki. These patterns enable machine-readable knowledge retrieval, filtering, aggregation, and discovery. They are not rules but tools—proven forms that can be adapted to specific needs.

Queries serve:
* '''Retrieval''': Finding what exists
* '''Filtering''': Narrowing to what matters
* '''Aggregation''': Summarizing across entities
* '''Discovery''': Revealing unexpected connections

== Basic Queries: Foundations of Discovery ==

=== Query 1: All Pages with Property ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has property::Value]]}}
```

'''Example:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]}}
```

'''Result:''' All pages with entity type "Idea"

=== Query 2: Property Exists ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has property::+]]}}
```

'''Examples:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has confidence score::+]]}}
{{#ask: [[Has confidence::+]]}}
{{#ask: [[Has confidence trajectory::+]]}}
{{#ask: [[Has evidence count::+]]}}
```

'''Result:''' All pages with any value for the specified property

=== Query 3: Multiple Properties ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has property1::Value1]]
[[Has property2::Value2]]
}}
```

'''Examples:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
[[Has confidence score::>0.8]]
}}

{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
[[Has confidence::high]]
}}

{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
[[Has confidence trajectory::established]]
}}
```

'''Result:''' Pages matching all specified conditions

== Comparison Queries: Finding Relations ==

=== Numeric Comparisons ===

'''Greater than:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has confidence score::>0.8]]}}
{{#ask: [[Has evidence count::>5]]}}
```

'''Less than:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has confidence score::<0.5]]}}
{{#ask: [[Has evidence count::<3]]}}
```

'''Range:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has confidence score::>0.5]]
[[Has confidence score::<0.9]]
}}

{{#ask: [[Has evidence count::>5]]
[[Has evidence count::<20]]
}}
```

=== Date Comparisons ===

'''After date:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has date::>2025-01-01]]}}
```

'''Before date:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has date::<2026-01-01]]}}
```

'''Date range:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has date::>2025-01-01]]
[[Has date::<2026-01-01]]
}}
```

== Filtered Queries: Narrowing the Field ==

=== Filter by Category ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Category:CategoryName]]}}
```

'''Example:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Category:BITwiki Ideas]]}}
```

=== Filter by Namespace ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Namespace:PageName]]}}
```

'''Example:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Idea:Feedback Loop]]}}
```

=== Exclude Values ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has property::!Value]]}}
```

'''Example:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::!Hypothetical]]}}
```

'''Result:''' All pages except those with status "Hypothetical"

== Aggregated Queries: Summarizing Knowledge ==

=== Count Results ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has property::Value]]
| format=count
}}
```

'''Example:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
| format=count
}}
```

'''Result:''' Number of matching entities

=== Sum Values ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has property::+]]
| ?Has numeric property
| format=sum
}}
```

'''Example:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Project]]
| ?Has budget
| format=sum
}}
```

=== Average Values ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has property::+]]
| ?Has numeric property
| format=average
}}
```

'''Examples:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
| ?Has confidence score
| format=average
}}

{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
| ?Has evidence count
| format=average
}}
```

== Sorted Queries: Ordering Results ==

=== Sort by Property ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has property::+]]
| sort=Property
| order=ascending
}}
```

'''Examples:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
| sort=Has confidence score
| order=descending
}}

{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
| sort=Has evidence count
| order=descending
}}

{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
| sort=Has confidence trajectory
| order=descending
}}
```

'''Result:''' Entities sorted by specified property

== Limited Queries: Managing Output ==

=== Limit Results ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has property::+]]
| limit=10
}}
```

'''Examples:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
| sort=Has confidence score
| order=descending
| limit=10
}}

{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
| sort=Has evidence count
| order=descending
| limit=10
}}
```

'''Result:''' Top N results by specified criteria

=== Offset Results ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has property::+]]
| offset=10
| limit=10
}}
```

'''Result:''' Results 11-20 (pagination)

== Display Formats: Presenting Results ==

=== Table Format ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has property::+]]
| format=table
}}
```

=== List Format ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has property::+]]
| format=list
}}
```

=== Category Format ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has property::+]]
| format=category
}}
```

=== Template Format ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has property::+]]
| format=template
| template=TemplateName
}}
```

== Advanced Patterns: Complex Discovery ==

=== Subqueries ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has property::{{#ask: [[Has subproperty::Value]]}}]]}}
```

=== Chain Queries ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has property::Value]]
| ?Has related property
}}
```

=== Inverse Queries ===

'''Pattern:'''
```wiki
{{#ask: [[-Has property::Value]]}}
```

'''Result:''' Pages that link to Value via Has property

== Common Use Cases: Patterns in Practice ==

=== Use Case 1: Find High-Confidence Ideas ===

```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
[[Has confidence score::>0.8]]
| sort=Has confidence score
| order=descending
| limit=20
}}
```

Alternative using evidence count:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
[[Has confidence::high]]
| sort=Has evidence count
| order=descending
| limit=20
}}
```

Alternative using confidence trajectory:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]]
[[Has confidence trajectory::established]]
| sort=Has confidence trajectory
| order=descending
| limit=20
}}
```

=== Use Case 2: Find Recent Publications ===

```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Publication]]
[[Has date::>2025-01-01]]
| sort=Has date
| order=descending
| limit=10
}}
```

=== Use Case 3: Find Verified Claims ===

```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::Verified]]
| sort=Has confidence score
| order=descending
}}
```

Alternative:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::Verified]]
| sort=Has evidence count
| order=descending
}}
```

=== Use Case 4: Count by Type ===

```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]]
| format=count
}}
```

== Property Variants Reference ==

This consolidated document includes multiple confidence-related property patterns used across BITwiki variants:

{| class="wikitable"
! Property !! Type !! Usage
|-
| Has confidence score || Numeric (0.0-1.0) || Quantitative confidence measurement
|-
| Has confidence || Categorical (high/medium/low) || Qualitative confidence level
|-
| Has confidence trajectory || Categorical (emerging/established/well-established) || Developmental stage
|-
| Has evidence count || Integer || Quantitative evidence support
|}

== References ==

# MediaWiki. (2026). Parser functions.
# BITwiki Ontology Index. (2026).
# BITwiki Constitution. (2026).
# W3C. (2013). SPARQL 1.1 Query Language.
# RDF Working Group. (2014). RDF 1.1 Concepts.
